name: pocket-pilot
description: Control your VS Code agent sessions (GitHub Copilot, Claude) from your phone, tablet or another computer. Free, end-to-end encrypted, passkey-protected. No servers.

commands.title: Sign In to GitHub for Auto-Reconnect
Run Pocket Pilot in This Window
Open the Pocket Pilot App on This PC

pocketPilot.autoStart.description: Start remote access automatically when VS Code starts (only after you have started it once yourself).

pocketPilot.pwaUrl.markdownDescription: Where the Pocket Pilot app is hosted (the QR code opens this URL). Leave empty to serve the app through the tunnel itself (not recommended: the tunnel URL changes, so the installed app and its keys would not survive a restart).

pocketPilot.extraAllowedOrigins.description: Additional web origins allowed to connect (e.g. a self-hosted copy of the app).

enumDescriptions: Free Cloudflare quick tunnel (no account). A new URL is created every time; paired devices find it again automatically.
Use your own public HTTPS URL that forwards to the local port (named Cloudflare tunnel, dev tunnel, Tailscale Funnel…).
No tunnel: only usable from this PC (testing).
pocketPilot.tunnel.mode.description: How your devices reach this PC.

pocketPilot.tunnel.customUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL forwarding to the local Pocket Pilot port (tunnel mode 'custom').

pocketPilot.tunnel.cloudflaredPath.description: Path to an existing cloudflared binary. Leave empty to use PATH or download the official release automatically.

pocketPilot.port.description: Local port for the relay (0 = pick a free port). Needed for the 'custom' tunnel mode.

pocketPilot.security.requireApproval.description: Ask for confirmation in VS Code before a new device is paired.

enumDescriptions: Devices must register a passkey (Face ID / Touch ID / fingerprint / Windows Hello / device PIN) and re-verify it periodically.
Use a passkey when the device supports it.
Do not use passkeys (device keys + end-to-end encryption only).

pocketPilot.security.passkeyGraceHours.description: How long a successful Face ID / fingerprint check stays valid before the device must verify again (0 = every connection).

pocketPilot.security.pairingCodeMinutes.description: How long a pairing QR code stays valid. Each code works only once.

pocketPilot.rendezvous.enabled.description: Keep a secret, end-to-end encrypted GitHub gist with the current tunnel URL so paired devices reconnect automatically after VS Code restarts.

pocketPilot.notifications.inputNeeded.description: Push a notification when an agent needs your approval or an answer.

pocketPilot.notifications.finished.description: Push a notification when an agent finishes a turn.

pocketPilot.notifications.errors.description: Push a notification when a session fails.

pocketPilot.notifications.skipWhileActiv.description: Do not push notifications while you are actively using this VS Code window.

pocketPilot.uploads.folder.description: Folder (relative to the session's working folder) where files sent from your devices are saved.
